title: Expert banks, frozen evidence, and authenticated numerical references

sources.notes: Recorded eager evidence has no program symbols; modeled only as unauthenticated Phase-0 evidence, including all_pass=false and zero/approximated timing fields.
Recorded graph evidence has no symbols and differs from freeze.yaml values; it is not promoted to authenticated oracle state.
Owns substring checks and CUDA-only workload measurement; only the evidence boundary is modeled, not vLLM execution.
Declarative geometry, format/hash and startup-gate contract; YAML has no code symbols and does not itself authenticate artifacts.
Shell environment preset for build concurrency and model selection; no function symbols or behavioral bank API.
Frozen compatibility/evidence values seed concrete scenarios but remain documentary until Phase-3 authentication.
Alternative synthetic graph-throughput configuration; no symbols and not equivalent to benchmark_cuda.py workloads.
Historical logical protocol-v1 schema and intended recovery; modeled only as frozen evidence because Phase 2 owns the later executable ABI.
Frozen workload/acceptance declaration; no code symbols and its broader correctness prose is distinguished from the implemented substring checker.
Twelve prompt/max-token/expected-substring records consumed by the Phase-0 harness; not a formal API or numerical proof.
Models fixed resident selection, ratio/alpha scale factorization, underflow guard, aligned six-plane write, atomic rename and optional byte comparison; FlashInfer conversion is abstract.
Models int4 source dependence, scale dtype, 4-GiB anonymous-RSS guard, transformed arenas, fresh-repack comparison and direct non-atomic destination publication; CUDA repack bytes are abstract.
NVFP4 record and total-size functions are modeled exactly; checkpoint discovery, fused scale constraint, one-layer residency, exact-size check and atomic replacement are represented.

Six-plane byte geometry, 4096 header extent, two qzero conventions, trivial g_idx, explicit resident IDs, exact sample validation and publication branches are modeled; dequant numerics remain implementation evidence.
Legacy one-expert golden path is inventoried and distinguished from authenticated Phase 3; tensor arithmetic is not reproduced symbolically.
Models exact header/size/source-byte acceptance and mismatch rejection; deterministic sampling and neighbor layer-shift diagnostics are documented but abstract.
Focused expert-0 compressed-tensors comparison and tiny numerical thresholds are inventory evidence, not the Phase-3 provenance model.
Build/orchestration file with no language symbols; establishes generator, normal/fault provider and mathematics-test dependencies only.

Models ordered identity authentication, 16 selected record audits, concrete quality thresholds, exact fixture size and atomic publication; float64 tensor computations are explicit external observations.
Models bounded staged rows/routes, zero bypass, budget relation and 2^-12 sensitivity; actual double/fp32 formulas remain source contracts for differential comparison.
Public domain types and algorithms define the oracle boundary represented by the reference state.

Named model scenarios correspond to authenticated success, zero bypass, stale provenance, split/fused failure with poison, M bounds and allocation accounting; hardware execution is not modeled as proof.
Exact size/digest/schema/layout/ID/padding/finite checks and bounded access are represented by authenticated identity state.
Packed fixture ABI and fixed H/I/top-k/layer/expert/input extents define concrete model bounds.
Supplies the concrete two-layer/eight-expert int4 layout witness and cross-owner header/plane/nonresident checks.
Owns SBB12X01 six-plane header geometry/path; the map records that the reader validates magic/version but not all derived/file-size properties.
Host mapping/pinning lifetime and fatal registration failure are documented; pageable/registered transfer implementation is outside the bank build state machine.
Canonical SBINT401 v2 ABI; int4DataOffset exactly mirrors _align_up/data_offset and the model preserves strict IDs, six planes, padding and version rejection.
Canonical SBMARL01 geometry, activation scale dtype, ordered IDs and exact-size reader define the transformed sidecar contract.

assumptions: The Reyu domains bound layers to 48, experts to 256, hidden size to 3072 and intermediate size to 1024; these cover the assigned concrete fixtures but are not universal format maxima.
Identity enums stand for exact source snapshot strings and SHA-256 values; digest computation and collision resistance are external, while fail-closed equality/order are modeled.
Integer milli-units abstract relative RMSE and cosine; the thresholds 180 and 980 mirror source values 0.18 and 0.98, but Reyu does not prove floating-point computations.
Comparison units in output-budget scenarios are representative bounded integers used to exercise <= and small-route observability; they are not claimed measured tensor deltas.
Sidecar plane derivation and GPU/FlashInfer transformations remain with their Python/CUDA implementations; the model checks aligned positive stride and exact header-plus-layer extent.
SBEXP001 source-layer identity is externally reconstructed from a contiguous checkpoint run because the format stores no layer-ID table.
A successful builder validation does not by itself qualify model placement, provider kernels, runtime transport or serving output.

implementation_checks.description: Instantiate BankShape(hidden=2048, intermediate=512, experts=256, 32 contiguous NVFP4 layers) and compare expert_bytes/total_bytes to Reyu nvfp4ExpertBytes(2048,512)=1769480 and nvfp4BankBytes(32,256,2048,512)=14495580220.
For resident counts 1, 8, 126 and 256, compare the Python data_offset with Reyu int4DataOffset(experts)=align4096(128+4*experts).
Derive the two-layer/eight-expert H=3072/I=1024 fixture and compare expert_stride=4866048 and total_bytes=77860864 with Reyu int4ExpertBytes/int4BankBytes.
CPU-only differential: serialize a valid header, then independently corrupt magic, version, reserved fields, ID order, padding and one plane offset; each malformed case must reject.
CPU-only synthetic-file check of derived plane geometry, activation scale dtype, ascending IDs and exact file-size rejection.
CPU source comparison: recompute geometry/stride/file extent around a parsed header and demonstrate which malformed size/geometry cases the current header-only reader does not reject.
On a tiny synthetic safetensors snapshot, compare extractor ordering and reciprocal bits, then shift a bank row and confirm the independent validator identifies byte mismatch/layer shift.
CPU-only mutation matrix over a copied fixture: whole digest, exact size, reserved bytes, offsets, fixed IDs and non-finite payloads must all reject before spans are exposed.

CPU-only compare canonical cases with independently recomputed route counts, absolute-weight sums and weighted magnitudes; verify zero bypass and the 2^-12 sensitivity predicate without launching a provider.
